powershell: function L($k,$v){ "$k=$v" }; "--- route to 192.168.1.0/24 ---"; (route print -4 | Select-String "192\.168\.1\." | Select-Object -First 6) -join " ; "; "--- ping ---"; (Test-Connection 192.168.1.109 -Count 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "reply " + $_.Address + " " + $_.ResponseTime + "ms" }) -join ","; "--- tracert ---"; (tracert -h 4 -w 700 192.168.1.109 2>&1 | Select-Object -Skip 2 -First 5) -join " ; "; "--- sunlogin on laptop ---"; (Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\Oray" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ","; "--- tailnet last seen desktop ---"; (& "E:\Tailscale\tailscale.exe" status --json | ConvertFrom-Json).Peer.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Value.HostName -match "IEUDGS" } | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.LastSeen }
